get.description: Return a list of all Distribution Groups associated with a Project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) matching the specified search query string.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Return items with the specified sort.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Parameter affecting what level of detail will be returned from the endpoint. 'extended' will include the users included in each distribution group.

parameters.name: include_ancestors
parameters.description:
Parameter affecting what groups will be returned from this endpoint. When 'true', this endpoint will only return distribution groups with users that match the provided (or default) `domain_id` and `min_ual` / `ual`.  Company level distribution groups will be returned as well if they have users matching the provided (or default) permissions.  If `extended` view is requested, only the users with matching permissions will be returned in the response. 
When `include_ancestors` is false or absent, only Project level groups will be returned.

parameters.name: domain_id
parameters.description: Parameter affecting the scope for the Distribution Groups, by default it is the Domain ID of the Submittals Tool. Will return only Distributions Groups who users that have access to the Tool specified by the domain_id. Only applies to requests that also have include_ancestors set to 'true'.

parameters.name: min_ual
parameters.description: Parameter affecting the scope for the Distribution Groups, by default it is the 'read' user access level. Will return only Distributions Groups who users that have the min ual specified by the 'min_ual'. Only applies to requests that also have include_ancestors set to 'true'.

parameters.name: ual
parameters.description: Parameter affecting the scope for the Distribution Groups.  Will return only Distributions Groups who users that have the exact ual specified by the 'ual'. If provided, this will take precendence over min_ual.  Only applies to requests that also have include_ancestors set to 'true'.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Login Information ID of the User

x-changelog.summary: Added new request parameter that will query groups based on the user access level.
x-changelog.description: Added 'min_ual' query parameter to filter users and groups by the specified parameter. Default to 'read'.
Documentation now correctly shows the `login` key inside of items in the `users` array in the example response body.

x-changelog.summary: Added Initials and Image URL to Extended View Response
x-changelog.description: User initials and avatar URL are now included in the response for the extended view

x-changelog.summary: Include Company Name and Job Title in projects distribution endpoint
x-changelog.description: Added company_name and job_title to the response body for the projects distribution endpoint

Documentation now also shows the `ual` parameter option that works with `include_ancestors`. This works similar to `min_ual`, except returns only distribution groups with users with an exact match. Also updated the description of `include_ancestors` to clarify that it will always filter the returned distribution groups to those with users matching certain permissions - it cannot be used to just include Company level distribution groups.

x-changelog.summary: Add Project Distribution Groups Show v1.0 endpoint
x-changelog.description: Added missing show Distribution Group endpoint

The Show endpoint now supports providing `include_ancestors` and the associated `domain_id`, `ual`, and/or `min_ual` parameters available on the List endpoint. This allows for viewing Company Level Distribution Groups with users that have permissions to a given project level domain.  It also supports returning only the distribution group members with specified permissions when `extended` view is also requested.
